notes.md: - **Foreign Trade Policy 2023:** announced 31 March 2023, in force from **1 April 2023**; unlike the earlier five-year EXIM/trade policies it has **no end date** and is updated when needed; target **$2 trillion** exports by 2030.

- **Law Commission chairs:** **18th** – **Justice A.R. Lakshmanan** (till 2009); **21st** – **Justice B.S. Chauhan**, issued a questionnaire on the **Uniform Civil Code** on **7 October 2016**; **23rd** – **Justice Dinesh Maheshwari** (from April 2025).
- **How it works:** takes up research on references from the **Central Government** or **suo motu** (on its own).
- **SEBI:** set up in **1988** as a non-statutory body by Government resolution; got statutory powers on **30 January 1992** under the **SEBI Act, 1992**.
